question_text: A bar magnet was moved quickly back and forth in a coil of copper wire. The ends of the wire were connected to a small lightbulb. Which of the following was the device created for?
choices: A: to generate an electric current
B: to increase the strength of the magnet
C: to heat the copper wire
D: to transfer protons to the lightbulb
